Revelation 4:5–11 explicitly worships the Creator ("you created all things" v.11) before the seven Spirits/lamps (v.5), while Revelation 21:1,5 & 22:1–5 announce the "new heaven and new earth" with light, throne, river of water of life, and tree of life.
results.uncertainty_note: Rev 4:11 and Rev 21–22 explicitly recall Creation theology and Eden motifs, whereas connecting Gen 1:2’s singular Spirit directly to Rev 4:5’s "seven Spirits" passes through Isa 11:2 / Zech 4:2–10 rather than an explicit Gen 1 citation inside Rev 4:5.
